entries.title: Node.js 27.0.0-alpha.0.0.0 (Alpha)
entries.content:
Rafael Gonzaga

2026-10-29, Version 27.0.0-alpha.0.0.0 (Alpha), @RafaelGSS

Notable Changes

V8 15.6

The V8 engine is updated to version 15.6.75.13, up from 14.6 in Node.js 26. Highlights:

  • New language features enabled by default: 
    Math.sumPrecise()
    , 
    Intl.Locale.prototype.variants
    , 
    Iterator.prototype.join()
    , 
    Iterator.prototype.includes()
    , 
    Iterator.zip()
    and 
    Iterator.zipKeyed()
    .
  • Experimental features behind flags: 
    import defer
    (
    --js-defer-import-eval
    ), Immutable 
    ArrayBuffer
    (
    --js-immutable-arraybuffer
    ) and RegExp buffer boundaries (
    --js-regexp-buffer-boundaries
    ).
  • Memory: when 
    --max-old-space-size
    is not set, the default heap size limit is now half of the physical memory clamped between 256 MB and 4 GB, and memory held by 
    Buffer
    and 
    ArrayBuffer
    instances now counts toward the heap limit. Applications that relied on the previous defaults should set 
    --max-old-space-size
    explicitly.
  • Serialization: 
    v8.serialize()
    , 
    structuredClone()
    and 
    postMessage()
    use a new format that older Node.js releases cannot read. 
    v8.cachedDataVersionTag()
    and the compile cache also change on every Node.js patch of V8, not only on V8 version changes.
  • Observable behavior changes: 
    Math
    methods now use LLVM's libm and may differ in the last bit; 
    Math.random()
    sequences change for a given 
    --random-seed
    ; 
    error.stack
    is no longer looked up through the prototype chain; 
    await
    incurs fewer microtasks; 
    Array.prototype.sort()
    uses PowerSort for large arrays and remains stable.
  • Heap snapshots include internal objects, numeric values and full script sources. Taking one takes about twice as long and the file is about twice as large.
  • WebAssembly: asm.js is no longer compiled to WebAssembly, and the 
    --experimental-wasm-
    flags are renamed 
    --wasm-
    .

A full changelog of the V8 changes between 14.6 and 15.6 will be shared soon.

Contributed by Joyee Cheung in #65161, #66537 and #66601.

entries.title: Node.js 26.13.0 (LTS)
entries.content:
Richard Lau

2026-10-28, Version 26.13.0 'Lithium' (LTS), @richardlau

Notable Changes

This release marks the transition of Node.js 26.x into Long Term Support (LTS) with the codename 'Lithium'. It will continue to receive updates through to the end of April 2029.

Other than updating metadata, such as the 

process.release
object, to reflect that the release is LTS, no further changes from Node.js 26.12.1 are included.

If you are updating from an earlier Long Term Support release (e.g. Node.js 24 or 22 or earlier) please note that since Node.js 25 the official binaries for Linux are linked against libatomic, which may need to be installed separately depending on your Linux distribution.
